description: identify carrying the Holocron extension key consent:"persistent" next to id, as a data-before-send callback adds it. Upstream strips the unknown key.

expected_upstream.notes: consent is not in the upstream schema and is ignored.

expected_holocron.notes: Client-asserted consent is accepted without a server-signed token: Confirmed (Mike, 2026-10-03) (docs/decisions/0001, Persistent consent transport). Honored only when the site has persistent_identity_enabled and the payload has an id; creates or refreshes the consent row; events link to the profile when granted_at <= event_time < revoked_at, no backfill. If persistent identity is not enabled the key is ignored and counted in consent_ignored.
